verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows mise generating its own AI insights or suggestions inside the product. The closest item is `mise mcp`, an MCP server that lets an external AI assistant read project data and run tasks. That is a building block for an outside AI, not an in-product AI capability, so it earns no credit. `mise outdated` is a deterministic version check, not AI-generated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: lets an AI assistant read a project's tools, tasks, environment variables and config files, and run its tasks
